NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: AirSpeak uses your microphone for pronunciation practice, AI conversation drills, and ICAO speaking assessment.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: AirSpeak transcribes your speech to evaluate aviation phraseology and ICAO Level 4 readiness.
NSCameraUsageDescription: AirSpeak uses your camera so you can take a profile photo.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: AirSpeak accesses your photo library to set your profile picture and attach images to community posts.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: AirSpeak saves community post images to your library when you choose to share them.
NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: AirSpeak does not track you across other companies' apps and websites. This permission is requested by iOS but is not used by AirSpeak.
